biotools.summary: The Human Reference Atlas (HRA) Knowledge Graph (KG) provides a data resource for HRA v2.2, supporting cross-scale biological queries using SPARQL. It is constructed and deployed following Linked Open Data principles, and provides APIs and interfaces for querying and retrieving data.
